conclusion: At the original 0.1 s step, A-Lite gives 186.9 s overall and 188.8 s with both devices. At the prespecified finest step (0.0125 s), the same plans give 186.8 s [182.6, 191.1] and 190.4 s respectively, on the same 60 fresh audiences. The finest-step study does not demonstrate a mean interval below 180 s. These are model predictions, not Bailey drill calibration.
